objective: Review the native parser-to-sidecar adapter handoff boundary and accept only the non-executing adapter payload definition before any implementation, sidecar runtime handoff, RTL simulation, timing, arbitrary RTL/filelist support, automatic allocation, upstream regression success, or upstream landing claim.

review_decision.reason: The definition correctly chooses a smaller native-parser adapter payload before the existing sidecar stage plan, instead of asking the parser to populate sidecar-owned state paths, coverage output targets, compare labels, generated report paths, or runtime artifacts.
review_decision.weakest_point: This is still only a reviewed boundary. No code yet maps V3Options or parser-stub output into an adapter helper, no sidecar stage plan is invoked from native parser data, no runtime ABI changes exist, no RTL simulation runs through this path, and no coverage-output equivalence or timing evidence exists for a native-parser handoff flow.
accepted_because: the boundary keeps parser-owned data limited to the accelerator selector, positive state/step counts, normalized shape, ordinary Verilator arguments, and preserved build inputs

the boundary references sidecar-owned source closure, coverage-output target, host-probe metadata, state paths, report paths, compare labels, and correctness policy without letting the parser infer them
the boundary reuses the existing sidecar stage plan and handoff-contract modules as the downstream target instead of inventing a second sidecar plan shape
compact shape spelling, estimate-efficiency, target registry lookup, operator print modes, resident workflows, and dataset-backed flows remain out of the native parser handoff minimum
the definition keeps generated reports and artifacts non-canonical and records no build, execution, timing, or upstream regression evidence

required_next_gate.name: implement_verilator_native_option_parser_sidecar_handoff_fixture_gate
must_implement: an importable, non-executing fixture or helper that maps the accepted parser-stub output into the reviewed native-parser adapter payload
tests proving parser-owned fields are preserved without source closure expansion or target registry lookup
tests proving sidecar-owned fields remain unresolved or rule-based until a sidecar plan layer resolves them
tests proving the helper keeps coverage_output_equivalence only as a later sidecar correctness-policy reference without running compare
tests proving the helper output does not contain resolved state_files, generated_reports, compare labels, coverage target, manifest refs, or host-probe metadata
documentation mention that this is a fixture/helper boundary, not native Verilator execution
must_not_do: infer arbitrary source closure or filelist dependencies
claim upstream Verilator regression success or landing

non_claims: not unqualified native Verilator parser support
not coverage-output equivalence for a native-parser flow
not a landed upstream Verilator patch
not a runtime or ABI change
not GEM benchmark or comparison evidence
reports and artifacts are generated evidence, not source of truth
